main_body: multi-gable timber-framed building with terracotta tile roof
top_band: terracotta tile roof slopes in warm orange/red/yellow-tan tones spanning rows 0-78 above the front walls (or rows 20-63 in the center recessed roof section)
evidence: Reading down a vertical column on the left gable peak (around row 0): rows 0-61 show the foreshortened sloped roof top surface with individual tiles, followed by the gable beam edge at rows 61-63, a dark shadow/timber border, and the vertical front wall face from row 62 down to row 142 (81 rows) featuring recessed windows, eaves shadows under the horizontal beams/roof overhangs (e.g. rows 64-65, 80-81), and inset door/window frames.

style.evidence: The candidate is an authentic Beodeul chipset building using the exact same roof tile ramp (6 steps from bright cream highlight to deep purple-brown shadow), plaster speckle texture, timber framing, and dark brown material-toned outlines as the reference buildings.
